newsitem.title: UK: Enterprise, Lasmo up after weekend report.
newsitem.headline: Enterprise, Lasmo up after weekend report.

text.p: Shares in Enterprise Oil Plc and Lasmo Plc rose in early trading on Monday after a report in the Financial Times on Saturday said they could be re-rated after a rumoured North Sea oil acquisition.
Lasmo was up 1p at 221-1/2 by 0806 GMT and Enterprise Oil was up 2-1/2p at 581-1/2.
Against the background of a strong oil price, and gains in major oil stocks in New York on Friday, British Petroleum Co Plc was up 3p at 699-1/2 after its ADRs rose $2 to $140-7/8.
Shell Transport & Trading Co was up 4-1/2p at 10.02-1/2 stg after Royal Dutch ADRs rose $4 to $172-1/8.

The FT said there was market talk that Kuwait-owned North Sea exploration company Santa Fe had been sold for over 1bn stg to Saga Petroleum of Norway, and said analysts said that figure could imply a re-rating of Lasmo and Enterprise.
